scope: Repeated warm-cache native-binary comparison using ACP read-only control RPCs and loopback HTTP/SSE only. Control RPC timing includes Python/stdio scheduling but no persistence, models or RSS-sampling subprocesses. Native PID RSS excludes the Python fixture, real models and external tools; sampled RSS is not a guaranteed production peak. No TLS handshake or real inference throughput is measured.

measurement.percentage_convention: (after - before) / before * 100; null when before is zero

implementation.candidateBasedOn: CLI entry-point deduplication, parse-only TOML and compact release dependency logging; no extra LLVM flags

interpretation: Local warm-cache timings are noisy and vary across repeated experiments; no universal speedup is claimed. All raw samples and paired changes are retained. Clean-runner comparisons are also required.
